description: Monthly Flood Event Dates for the Keta Municipality, Volta Region, Ghana. is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Historical flood event records provided by the Keta office of NADMO and archived by the author. Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
